items.title: Blue screen appears after installing an update
items.content:
Problem: Blue screen appears after installing an update on Windows 10. This started this morning.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Installed pending driver updates and repaired Windows update components.

items.title: Application installation fails with permission error
items.content:
Problem: Application installation fails with permission error on Ubuntu. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Used the approved installer with administrator permission.

items.title: Remote Desktop shows credential error
items.content:
Problem: Remote Desktop shows credential error on macOS. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Enabled the approved RDP rule and verified the device was reachable.
